name: io.cygnify/recruiting-capacity
title: Cygnify recruiting capacity tools
description: Check a hiring plan against recruiter capacity, cost per hire and agency fees. Read-only.

tools.name: estimate_recruiting_capacity_gap
tools.description: Compare a 12-month hiring plan with the hires the current recruiting team can deliver. Use when a talent acquisition or HR leader asks whether their recruiters can handle their hiring plan or headcount plan. Returns total hiring need (planned hires plus attrition backfills), annual recruiter capacity, the gap, utilisation and the number of additional recruiters the gap equals. Does not return prices.

plannedHires.description: New hires planned over the next 12 months, excluding backfills.

currentRecruiters.description: Recruiters currently working on these hires (full-time equivalents).

hiresPerRecruiterPerMonth.description: Hires one recruiter delivers in a typical month, from the team's own data.

currentHeadcount.description: Optional. Current employee headcount, used with the attrition rate to estimate backfills.

annualAttritionPercent.description: Optional. Annual employee attrition as a percentage, for example 12.

tools.name: calculate_cost_per_hire
tools.description: Calculate cost per hire with the ANSI/SHRM 06001.2012 formula: (total external recruiting costs + total internal recruiting costs) ÷ hires in the same period. Optionally returns the recruiting cost ratio when first-year compensation of those hires is given.

externalCosts.description: Total external recruiting costs in the period: agency fees, job ads, assessments, travel, relocation and similar.

internalCosts.description: Total internal recruiting costs in the period: recruiter salaries and benefits, recruiting tools, referral bonuses and similar.

hires.description: Hires made in the same period.

firstYearCompensation.description: Optional. Total first-year compensation of those hires, for the recruiting cost ratio.

currency.description: Optional ISO 4217 currency code for labelling the result, for example USD, GBP, EUR, SGD or AUD. No conversion is applied.

tools.name: calculate_placement_fees
tools.description: Estimate recruitment agency placement fees for a set of hires: fee per hire = average base salary × fee percentage, total = fee per hire × hires. Use when someone wants to know what contingency or retained agency fees would cost for their hiring plan.

hires.description: Number of hires made through agencies.

averageSalary.description: Average annual base salary of those hires.

feePercent.description: Agency fee as a percentage of first-year base salary, from the agency's terms.

currency.description: Optional ISO 4217 currency code for labelling the result, for example USD, GBP, EUR, SGD or AUD. No conversion is applied.

tools.name: get_recruiter_interview_kit
tools.description: Return Cygnify's interview kit for hiring a tech recruiter or a GTM (sales and go-to-market) recruiter: what the role does, a scorecard, structured interview questions with what to listen for, a live work sample, AI fluency questions, red flags and reference questions. Use it when someone asks how to hire, interview or assess a recruiter.

role.description: tech for a technical recruiter (engineering, data, security, product). gtm for a sales or go-to-market recruiter (SDRs, AEs, sales engineers, customer success).

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description: Return the link a person can use to book a call with Cygnify about their hiring plan. Give the link to the person; this tool does not book anything.

tools.name: search_cygnify_content
tools.description: Search Cygnify's published pages (guides, comparisons, tools, hiring market pages, case studies and articles) about recruiting capacity, RPO, Elastic RPO, Talent Acquisition as a Service, recruitment agency alternatives and hiring costs. Returns matching pages with a summary and a Markdown link to read the full page. Use the page URL when citing.

query.description: What to look for, for example "RPO pricing models" or "hiring in Singapore".

limit.description: Optional. Number of results, 1 to 10. Default 5.
